summary: Added watch-stopped reporting. In web/src/lib/home.ts: new WATCHER_STOPPED_SENTENCE, watcherCallout(live) (undefined→null, watcher_stopped first, then watching→null else NOT_WATCHING_SENTENCE), and LiveState + liveState() with order down→stopped→match→watching→idle. LiveStatus.tsx now uses LiveState, adds 'Watcher stopped'/'bg-warn' entries, computes via liveState with Boolean(live.data?.watcher_stopped), and shows WATCHER_STOPPED_SENTENCE in the panel when stopped. CurrentMatchView.tsx uses watcherCallout(live.data) in the no-match branch and prepends the stopped callout to the opening-hand, intermission and match branches when watcher_stopped. FirstRun.tsx turns STEPS into a function of live with watcherCallout(live) ?? NOT_WATCHING_SENTENCE. All three checks passed: test (622), tsc -b, lint.
concerns: Confirm the stopped callout div placement/className exactly matches the spec in all three CurrentMatchView branches.
Check the no-match branch uses watcherCallout(live.data) rather than a separate watcher_stopped test.
